name: free-agents
description: Run Claude Code on FREE inference — two equal lanes: local MLX models on Apple Silicon, and free cloud APIs (Gemini, Groq, NVIDIA, and a dozen more). MAIN use: dispatch delegatable sub-tasks from your paid session to a free model, keeping your capable model driving. ALSO: full free sessions via `csl` (local) or `csl remote` (free APIs) — remote is faster and is the preferred lane for most interactive work; local wins for long unattended runs. Blind-trust auto mode by default with sandbox.enabled bypass. Additive overlay: private paths/keys in a gitignored config.local, settings.json untouched. Works whether Claude Code connects to Anthropic directly or via a gateway.
